mapper.select: /* ChkptLinkMapper.selectActiveChkptLinksBySrcSite */ SELECT L.LINK_ID AS linkId , L.DST_CMPNY_CD AS dstCmpnyCd , L.DST_SITE_CD AS dstSiteCd FROM TB_SITE_LINK L WHERE L.SRC_CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND L.SRC_SITE_CD = #{srcSiteCd} AND L.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND L.CHKPT_LINK_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND L.DST_SITE_CD IS NOT NULL ORDER BY L.LINK_ID ASC

/* ChkptLinkMapper.selectSrcChkptList */ SELECT A.CHKLST_TYPE AS chkLstType , A.CHKPT_CD AS chkptCd , A.CHKPT_NM AS chkptNm , A.CHKPT_DESC AS chkptDesc , A.USE_YN AS useYn FROM TB_CHKPT_TYPE_MGMT A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{srcSiteCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.CHKLST_TYPE, A.CHKPT_CD

/* ChkptLinkMapper.selectSrcInspectItemList */ SELECT A.CHKLST_TYPE AS chkLstType , A.INSPECT_ITEM_CD AS inspectItemCd , A.INSPECT_ITEM_SUBJ AS inspectItemSubj , A.SORT_IDX AS sortIdx , A.STR_DATE AS strDate , A.USE_YN AS useYn FROM TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ITEM A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{srcSiteCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.CHKLST_TYPE, A.SORT_IDX, A.INSPECT_ITEM_CD
/* ChkptLinkMapper.selectNewInspectItemCd */ SELECT CONCAT( 'DCHK' , '_' , CAST(#{chkLstType} AS UNSIGNED) , '_' , FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{dstCmpnyCd}, CONCAT('COM001-', #{chkLstType})) )
mapper.insert: /* ChkptLinkMapper.insertMirrorChkpt */ INSERT INTO TB_CHKPT_TYPE_MGMT ( CMPNY_CD , SITE_CD , CHKLST_TYPE , CHKPT_CD , CHKPT_NM , CHKPT_DESC , MGMT_USER_CD , USE_YN , LINK_SRC_CMPNY_CD , LINK_SRC_SITE_CD , LINK_SRC_CHKPT_CD , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT #{dstCmpnyCd} , #{dstSiteCd} , S.CHKLST_TYPE , #{chkptCd} , S.CHKPT_NM , S.CHKPT_DESC , NULL , S.USE_YN , #{srcCmpnyCd} , #{srcSiteCd} , S.CHKPT_CD , 'SYSTEM' , NOW() , 'SYSTEM' , NOW() FROM TB_CHKPT_TYPE_MGMT S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{srcSiteCd} AND S.CHKPT_CD = #{srcChkptCd}

/* ChkptLinkMapper.insertMirrorInspectItem */ INSERT INTO TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ITEM ( CMPNY_CD , SITE_CD , CHKLST_TYPE , INSPECT_ITEM_CD , INSPECT_ITEM_SUBJ , SORT_IDX , STR_DATE , USE_YN , LINK_SRC_CMPNY_CD , LINK_SRC_SITE_CD , LINK_SRC_ITEM_CD , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT #{dstCmpnyCd} , #{dstSiteCd} , S.CHKLST_TYPE , #{inspectItemCd} , S.INSPECT_ITEM_SUBJ , S.SORT_IDX , CAST( GREATEST( CAST(S.STR_DATE AS UNSIGNED) , CAST(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') AS UNSIGNED) ) AS CHAR ) , S.USE_YN , #{srcCmpnyCd} , #{srcSiteCd} , S.INSPECT_ITEM_CD , 'SYSTEM' , NOW() , 'SYSTEM' , NOW() FROM TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ITEM S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{srcSiteCd} AND S.INSPECT_ITEM_CD = #{srcItemCd}

/* ChkptLinkMapper.insertMirrorInspectItemHist */ INSERT INTO TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ITEM_HIST ( CMPNY_CD , SITE_CD , CHKLST_TYPE , INSPECT_ITEM_CD , CHG_TYPE , INSPECT_ITEM_SUBJ , STR_DATE , SORT_IDX , USE_YN , LINK_SRC_CMPNY_CD , LINK_SRC_SITE_CD , LINK_SRC_ITEM_CD , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE ) SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , A.SITE_CD , A.CHKLST_TYPE , A.INSPECT_ITEM_CD , #{chgType} , A.INSPECT_ITEM_SUBJ , A.STR_DATE , A.SORT_IDX , A.USE_YN , A.LINK_SRC_CMPNY_CD , A.LINK_SRC_SITE_CD , A.LINK_SRC_ITEM_CD , 'SYSTEM' , NOW() FROM TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ITEM A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{dstCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{dstSiteCd} AND A.INSPECT_ITEM_CD = #{inspectItemCd}
mapper.select: /* ChkptLinkMapper.selectChkptParentTier */ SELECT T.LINK_SRC_CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , T.LINK_SRC_SITE_CD AS siteCd , T.CHKLST_TYPE AS chkLstType , T.LINK_SRC_CHKPT_CD AS chkptCd FROM TB_CHKPT_TYPE_MGMT T WHERE T.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND T.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND T.CHKPT_CD = #{chkptCd} AND T.LINK_SRC_CMPNY_CD IS NOT NULL AND T.LINK_SRC_SITE_CD IS NOT NULL AND T.LINK_SRC_CHKPT_CD IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1
